releases.body:
## Fixes
* OpenCode 2: when another session's snippet command holds the project lock, a prompt that could not expand stays literal for that turn only and expands on the next one. A turn waits for a busy lock at most once, and other sessions that overlap briefly afterwards still expand. A snippet error that the user has to fix stays final, so fixing the snippet never re-runs an old message's shell commands (e19beb5, 72577b6, e5cd783, 8dbf4f7, 6c6bd7b, 650d7ad, 155c021)
* OpenCode 2: an edited message is never patched with the expansion stored for its earlier text (0a11cc8)
* Library: text pasted while a save is in progress stays in the editor as unsaved changes and is saved with the next save (5cae180)
* TUI: closing the "Create snippet?" confirmation with Escape, ctrl+c or a backdrop click no longer leaves the OpenCode 1 prompt disabled (f9a0670)
* TUI: accepting a broken draft from a partial query, such as `#fresh` for `#fresh-global`, reopens that draft and no longer creates a stray `fresh.md` (c25474f)
* A failed `/snippets reload`, for example when the project snippet folder is a symbolic link, keeps the previously loaded snippets working in every session (08140f6)
* OpenCode 1: deleting a session releases its loaded skills and injected reminders and stops pending injection markers for it (a1c53c4, 31cbcc6)

## Features
* Skill completion in the TUI refreshes when OpenCode reports a `skill.updated` event (2ce4052)

## Fixes
* When only a plural `snippets/` directory exists, globally or in `.opencode/`, `config.jsonc` is read and created there. The plugin no longer creates an empty `snippet/` directory on every startup. By @bew in https://github.com/JosXa/opencode-snippets/pull/34
* The watcher polls hidden snippet directories that Bun `fs.watch` misses on Linux (52d0da7)
* The build writes outside `dist` and then moves the files in, so running V2 watchers keep the plugin loaded (7b9dff5)
* Removed snippet directories are refreshed, and editor drafts are recovered (6555128)

## Docs
* Redesigned README with a logo, icon headings and an animated demo

## New Contributors
* @bew made their first contribution in https://github.com/JosXa/opencode-snippets/pull/34

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/JosXa/opencode-snippets/compare/v3.4.0...v3.5.0
